title: Algorithmia
tagline: Test your Data Structures & Algorithms skills.
fullDescription: A Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) competition consisting of 4-5 questions on the HackerEarth platform. Partial solutions are allowed, and time will be used as the tie breaker. [cite: 1, 3, 4, 5, 6]

title: BackTrack
tagline: Decode, pattern find, and code reverse engineering problems.
fullDescription: Participants will be given 5-6 Reverse Engineering questions. They must decode the underlying pattern using the custom platform by observing input and output, and then code the pattern and submit it on HackerEarth. [cite_start]Partial solutions are allowed, and time is the tie breaker. [cite: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]

title: CS QUIZ
tagline: Test your knowledge in CS core topics across two challenging rounds.
fullDescription: A two-round quiz event for teams of 2. Round 1 involves 40 MCQs from CS core topics (DBMS, OS, DSA, DAA, LR, C/C++/Java) on HackerEarth. [cite_start]The Top 10 teams advance to Round 2, which requires strong problem-solving and analytical skills using pen & paper. [cite: 16, 17, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27]
rules: Knowledge of CS Core topics is essential.
venue: Round 1: HackerEarth (30 mins). [cite_start]Round 2: Pen & Paper (45 mins). [cite: 18, 19, 25, 26]

title: Replicode / Mini Hackathon
tagline: Replicate design and functionality of given web components.
fullDescription: Participants are provided with 3-4 components (Frontend + Backend) and must replicate their designs and functionality. Judging is manual, with more points awarded to replicas closer to the source. [cite_start]Internet and LLMs are allowed. [cite: 45, 46, 47, 48]
rules: Experience with Frontend and Backend development.
venue: Custom Platform + Local IDE. [cite_start]Duration: 90 mins / 120 mins. [cite: 42, 43]

title: Workshop
fullDescription: The topic and details for the workshop are yet to be decided. [cite: 49]

title: Game (Crypt of the Necrodancer)
fullDescription: A 60-minute competition featuring the rhythm-based dungeon crawler, Crypt of the Necrodancer. [cite: 50, 52]

title: Meet up Mania
fullDescription: The format and details for the 'Meet up Mania' event are yet to be decided. [cite: 54]

title: Emoji Charades
tagline: Guess the movie name using only emojis.
fullDescription: A team-based game where one person sends emojis to their teammate, who must guess the movie name. [cite_start]Sides are switched at each turn. [cite: 58, 59]

title: Typing
tagline: Fast and accurate paragraph typing challenge.
fullDescription: A 30-minute typing competition where participants type a given paragraph. [cite_start]The paragraph includes checkpoints, and each mistake drives the participant to the nearest checkpoint. [cite: 62, 64, 65]

title: Pitch 2 Rich
tagline: Develop and pitch a business proposal to judges.
fullDescription: A two-round event for teams of 4-5. Round 1 requires teams to submit a business proposal, with the Top 5 shortlisted. [cite_start]Round 2 requires the shortlisted teams to present their idea on stage to the judges, with a maximum pitch time of 20 minutes. [cite: 67, 69, 70, 72, 73]

title: Treasure Hunt
tagline: Solve puzzles and riddles across the NIT Campus.
fullDescription: A two-round event for teams of 5. Round 1 involves 40 questions (Puzzles, NIT Based GK) on a custom platform (30-40 mins). The Top 5 teams move to Round 2, which is a 3-hour physical hunt on the NIT Campus. [cite_start]The exact format of Round 2 is to be decided. [cite: 75, 76, 78, 79, 80, 81, 82, 83]

title: Destinite
tagline: Live 1 on 1 interview competition for top performers.
fullDescription: A 2-hour event featuring a live 1 on 1 interview format for the Top 3 performers. [cite: 86, 88]
rules: Open only to the Top 3 performers (selection method TBD).
